title: High-throughput methods to design deformable recrystallized boracite solid electrolytes: challenges and solutions
content:
Energy Adv., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5YA00188A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jean-Danick Lavertu, Sibyl Martasek, Sara Reardon, Shipeng Jia, Antranik Jonderian, Giyun Kwon, Youngjoon Bae, Eric McCalla
Cl-containing boracites are produced in high-throughput for the first time by overcoming extreme elemental loss. New mechanisms for material degradation are uncovered including reactions with humid air.
